children: Bangkok Expressway and Metro likely has positive catalysts over next 2 years, ttb wealth securities' Saksid Phadthananarak says in a report. The transport company is expected to secure bondholder approval this month to raise debt covenant ratio to 3.0x from 2.5x, easing concerns over potential cash calls. Also, the Thailand company is likely to be awarded two projects in 2027 and is expected to deliver a THB10-per-trip toll increase in September 2028 that should drive earnings to a record high in 2029. The brokerage raises the stock's target price to 8.20 baht from THB8.00 to reflect a base-year rollover, with an unchanged buy rating. Shares are 0.8% higher at THB6.65. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
